poll.question: Wesley's hands won't stop shaking. Should Chills move closer... or wait?

options.label: Move closer
options.desc: Hold each other steady. Their bond is shelter.

options.label: Sit still
options.desc: Witness him. Let Wesley's tremor matter, become his anchor.

options.label: Watch Mutu's way
options.desc: The cat has no fear. What if stillness is gravity?

in_play.label: Face it together
in_play.desc: Pull Mutu in. Stay awake as three. The panther meets all of you.
